## Goal
Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear and watch your plot grow, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy upgrades there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair

## You
retailtycoonlover21 (helmet None); role: nozzle (fight fires)

## On-screen UI
Your observation's `ui` lists the on-screen buttons you can see (text, path, gui, x/y) and `panels` the open windows (title). To use one, reply {"action": "press", "args": {"path": "<path from ui>"}} (or {"text": "Claim"}). It is a real mouse click; the result says whether the button fired and what changed on screen (panels opened or closed, new buttons, HUD text).
Test a feature with a menu (shop, pass, inventory, upgrades, settings) through its buttons: open its panel, press its action buttons (Claim, Buy, Equip, ...), then check the result and the next observation for the effect. A button that does not fire, or fires and changes nothing, is a bug to report.

## UI features assigned to you
Press each of these UI features at least once this round: open it with its button, then press its action buttons and check the effect. A button that does not fire, or a panel that opens but whose actions change nothing, is a bug to report.
- SHOP (gui ShopUi)
- REBIRTH $10.0K (0%) (gui RebirthGui)
- REBIRTH, then: REBIRTH $

## Macro actions
Every step is ONE decision, so make each one finish a whole interaction. Prefer these macros:
- go_use {"path": "<prompt path>", "action": "<its action text>"}: walk into range of the ProximityPrompt on that part (copy `path` and `action` from `prompts`, or a path from `things`) and use it, holding if needed.
- go_touch {"path": "<part path>"}: walk to a part from `touchables` or `things` and stand on it until it registers a touch (buy pads, buttons, checkpoints, zones).
- chase {"path": "<moving part or model>", "touches": 1-5}: follow a moving thing (enemy, drone, NPC, ball) and touch it that many times.
- repeat {"action": "go_use", "args": {...}, "times": 2-5}: the same action several times in a row, to test spam and double use (double buys, spammed claims, double-tapped prompts).
Each macro returns `effect`: what changed (leaderstats, your attributes, counters, HUD text, game events). Judge the feature by that effect; "nothing changed" after a buy, claim or touch is a bug to report. Keep move_to / interact / key / spray for fine positioning and fighting.
